name: example-agency-marketing-site
title: marketing-site page kind
description: A static marketing site page kind: a hero, three features, three testimonials, three pricing tiers, one call to action and a footer. Fits a software or subscription product that sells itself from one page. Composed from six vendored HyperUI marketing blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the marketing-site family for a static marketing site mock: a hero, three features, optional social proof, optional pricing, a call to action and a footer. Ask for the product, its audience and what it sells, generate a schemaVersion 2 marketing-site typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder.
